messages:
incident-bot: Paging on-call: multiple regional health-check alerts detected for route /v1/generate. Pattern: probe flips causing requests to spiral between us-east -> us-west -> eu. Escalation level: P1. @lia is on-call. :rotating_light:
lia: ACK. looking now. can someone drop the regional routing policy into passive so we stop the spiral?
devon: I'm seeing a tight 10s healthprobe TTL on the regional probe that lines up with the flips. policy 'smart-route-v2' will bounce after two failed health checks -> fallback to next region, which then immediately flips back.
samuel: confirming logs show the three region health states bouncing within 30s windows. this is causing a route-churn loop. attach sample:```json
{"ts":"2026-03-15T09:12:01Z","region":"us-east","probe":"healthy"}
{"ts":"2026-03-15T09:12:11Z","region":"us-east","probe":"unhealthy"}
{"ts":"2026-03-15T09:12:21Z","region":"us-west","probe":"healthy"}
{"ts":"2026-03-15T09:12:31Z","region":"us-west","probe":"unhealthy"}
{"ts":"2026-03-15T09:12:41Z","region":"eu","probe":"healthy"}
{"ts":"2026-03-15T09:12:51Z","region":"eu","probe":"unhealthy"}```
lia: thanks. customer-impact? how many requests affected / error rates?
karen: PSA from CS — a handful of enterprise customers noticed increased 5xx and timeouts in the last 20m. nothing widespread yet but one customer (acme-inc) reported request spikes and latency.
mike: telemetry: 5xx rate on /v1/generate jumped from 0.3% to 4.1% across the three regions; p50 latency increased ~120ms for routed requests because of fallback retries.
elena: traffic shift graph shows ~18% of traffic was in flight while route hops occurred -> duplicate connection overhead.
lia: plan: 1) mute smart-route-v2 (force policy to return single-region preference) 2) increase healthprobe debounce to 45s as temporary 3) open canary pin to model-variant stable in us-east to break variant mismatch risk 4) notify customers. any objections?
devon: +1. I'll prepare the override. command I'd run:```bash
redwoodctl routing policy override set --name smart-route-v2 --mode passive --reason "incident: region probe oscillation"```
samuel: I'll also increase probe debounce:```bash
redwoodctl infra probes update --probe regional-health --debounce 45s --window 3```
opsbot: deploy job started: routing-override-2026-03-15T09:20Z (job id rj-99827)
lia: doing customer comms now. @karen please prepare blurb, state we're mitigating and we may pause regional failovers.
karen: sending to impacted customers: "We are investigating intermittent failures and have applied temporary routing changes to stabilize requests. We will follow up with a timeline and postmortem."
devon: override applied. policy now passive, fallback disabled for smart-route-v2. verifying traffic.
samuel: probe debounce increased. I'm seeing probe flip rate drop significantly, routing churn stopped within 30s.
mike: metrics: 5xx back down to 0.5% in last 3 minutes, p50 latency normalizing.
elena: confirmed no further hop traces in distributed tracing.
lia: good. leaving this channel open for 1hr watch. please don't close until incident-bot sees stable windows.
incident-bot: Monitoring: stable window detection started (target: 10min).
devon: root cause hypothesis: autopilot config deployed yesterday changed probe window from 60s -> 10s and a small network jitter in us-east caused a flapping threshold to be met. combined with immediate fallback policy we got quick cross-region bounce.
samuel: follow-ups: 1) revert autopilot probe change in staging and add e2e test for jitter resilience, 2) add hysteresis to smart-route-v2 (prefer holdover for N seconds before failing over), 3) postmortem and customer RCA.
lia: assigning owners: devon -> routing policy hysteresis; samuel -> probe defaults rollback & tests; karen -> customer follow-up + RCA email; mike -> metrics dashboard tile for fast detection.
opsbot: incident status updated -> mitigated. watch period active.
lia: thanks team. final note: avoid blanket disable of routing without canary in future but for this P1 it was the fastest stable path. I'll draft the postmortem and link here.
karen: customers notified with interim update.
incident-bot: Incident marked mitigated at 2026-03-15T09:32:25Z. Auto-close scheduled in 60m if stable. :white_check_mark:
